owner_decision: 9 Oct 2026 WIB: Hapus data kerja yang benar-benar sementara setelah analisis DONE dan seluruh hasil final tersimpan serta terverifikasi (6 syarat).

kept: jobs (query, reference, source hash, access, times)
verified_before_removal: header and every page hash their bodies
plan scope exists and one plan row per target (count)
cleanup.not_rederived_before_removal: P20 F04 (independent audit 9 Oct 2026, AS20-39): the plan index content (plan_targets values), plan scope content, page range metadata and header totals are not re-derived from the page bodies; they are protected by the immutable-run trigger (55000 CP7_RUN_IMMUTABLE), not by the cleanup verifier. With that trigger deliberately disabled on a copy, such changes are not detected before CLEANED.
cleanup.removal_without_table_lock: Independent audit Fable F-OPS-02: clean_done, purge_expired and purge_intermediates no longer suspend the immutable triggers with ALTER TABLE (a SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE lock that made a running analysis's unit insert wait until the 8 s limit). They name the job (and its run, for pages) in a transaction-local setting; the work tables' and pages' trigger (cp7_analysis_stage.work_immutable) lets through a DELETE of exactly those rows and refuses every other change (55000 CP7_RUN_IMMUTABLE). purge_expired also gives up on a busy row after 2 s (lock_timeout).

nightly_backup.verified_by: restore into a separate scratch database; every table's row count and md5 equal to the source read in the dump's own exported snapshot (pg_dump --snapshot), so writes during the backup do not affect the comparison (Fable F-OPS-03)
nightly_backup.attempt_name: erp-<YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS>-WIB-<random token>.dump; an existing dump or receipt name is refused before anything is written (P20 F03)
nightly_backup.scratch: any name other than the source and postgres; the tool marks the database it creates (database comment) and drops only a database with its mark; any other existing database is refused (BACKUP_SCRATCH_EXISTS_NOT_OURS) and left unchanged; the scratch is made with createdb and never dropped first, so a database of that name appearing after the check makes createdb fail instead of being dropped (Fable F-OPS-01)

synthetic_steps: a page hash changed and restored to stand for an unverifiable result
TEST_SCHEDULE_OVERRIDE on the disposable race copy
two other databases created and removed by the scratch guard case (one of them made to appear after the check)
a test table written to through a backup, then dropped
schedule_job_name: pg_cron job name = <schedule name>@<database> (P20 F02): installing for one database never moves another database's jobs; reinstall is idempotent; a same-named job of another database is refused before any change
schedules_k4_note: 9 Oct 2026: cp7-staged-runner (K4) added to the same server schedule; its cases are the k4-runner suite (docs/cp7/k4/K4_RUNNER.json). No K3 check changed.
schedules_k6_note: 11 Oct 2026: cp7-proof-runner (K6, PL-8 proof runner) added to the same server schedule; its cases are the k6-proof-runner suite (docs/cp7/k6/K6_PROOF_RUNNER.json). No K3 check changed.
schedule_installer: scripts/cp7_schedule.py: install requires --installation-approved, uninstall requires --removal-approved, and --database must be the database of --erp-url (CP7_SCHEDULE_DATABASE_MISMATCH, Fable F-OPS-04)
